name: FTAM Classic: Origins
author: redstonecharger@gmail.com
description: Minecraft 1.7.10 Forge modpack. Each start runs the pack's latest release, or the one set in Pack release.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null
cd /mnt/server
[ -d pack/.git ] || { rm -rf pack; git clone -q https://github.com/iRedSC/FTAM-Classic-Origins.git pack; }
git -C pack fetch -q --tags --force origin
git -C pack show origin/main:pterodactyl/start.sh > start.sh

variables.name: Pack release
variables.description: latest, or a release tag to pin or roll back to.
